title: WASD Face
cue: faces: blinking, eyes that follow, a mouth moved by voice
summary: A character's face in one node: blinks, eyes and a head that turn to what they look at, a mouth that follows any voice recording's loudness, and expressions, on models with face shapes or eye bones.
useWhen: A character is seen up close or speaks: a hero in third person, a shopkeeper, a companion, anyone in a dialogue or a cutscene. Works on MPFB humans given a face as the mpfb guide says, on VRM models, on models with ARKit's shapes, and on any model with blink and mouth blend shapes or eye bones.
avoidWhen: Characters seen only from afar or in a crowd; a model with neither face blend shapes nor eye bones, which it cannot move; or lip sync by phoneme, which needs visemes made for each line.
